description: This file defines the UpdateModelEvent class within the Goteo project's core event system. The class extends AbstractModelEvent and encapsulates data related to updating a model, including fields and conditions.

classes.name: UpdateModelEvent
classes.description: Represents an event for updating a model, containing fields to update and conditions to identify the target records.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the UpdateModelEvent with the given model, fields to update, and conditions for updating.

methods.name: getFields
methods.description: Returns the fields to be updated in the model.

methods.name: getWhere
methods.description: Returns the conditions used to identify which records to update.
